findings.issue: Task 15 automated verification step uses the grep pattern: grep -E "^### Focus Area [1-7]" to count focus area sections. However, the required report structure uses a single section named 'Focus Area Verdicts' containing sub-sections for each of the 7 areas — the task description does NOT prescribe the format '### Focus Area N' for each sub-section. The grep will likely return 0 or fewer than 7 matches if the agent follows the report structure as described, causing the verification step to fail even for a correctly-written audit report.
findings.fix: Either: (a) prescribe the exact heading format '### Focus Area 1: CSRF Wiring' through '### Focus Area 7: RememberMeCookieSerializer' in the report structure section so the grep matches; or (b) change the verification grep to 'grep -cE "^### (Focus Area|[1-7]\.)" ... | grep -qE "[7-9]|[1-9][0-9]+"' or use a simpler prose check. The current grep is likely to fail on a correct report.

findings.issue: Task 15 automated verification uses: grep -cE "^- A0[1-9]|^- A10" to count OWASP entries. The required report structure says 'OWASP Top 10 Sweep — one row per A01–A10', which naturally maps to a Markdown table (| A01 | ... |) or a definition list. If the agent uses a table format, lines start with '|' not '-', and the grep returns 0. If the agent uses a bullet list starting with '- A01:' the grep would match. The format is underspecified, creating a brittle verification gate.
findings.fix: Prescribe the exact OWASP section format in the report structure: either require a Markdown table with columns (| Category | Verdict | Justification |) and update the grep to match table rows, or require '- A01: ...' bullet format explicitly and keep the grep as-is.

findings.issue: Task 15 automated verification uses: grep -cE "^(Critical|High|Medium|Low):" to count findings and requires the count to match Executive Summary tally. However the required report structure says 'Findings — one entry per finding, severity-graded (Critical / High / Medium / Low)'. This is underspecified — if the agent writes '**Critical:** ...' or '### Critical Findings' or uses a table, the grep returns 0. The verification gate will produce false failures on correctly-written reports.
findings.fix: Prescribe the exact finding header format. Example: require each finding to start with 'Critical:', 'High:', 'Medium:', or 'Low:' on its own line (matching the grep). Add this format requirement to the report structure section.
